title: UI风格#97 - Swiss Poster (瑞士海报)
description: 创建第97种UI风格：瑞士海报风格 - 网格系统、Helvetica、无衬线极简。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCS.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss Poster style When color palette Then features Swiss red, pure black, pure white, cool gray
Given Swiss Poster style When typography Then uses helvetica-style: Helvetica Neue, Neue Haas Grotesk, or Activity
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Helvetica Neue (标题), Neue Haas Grotesk (正文), Activity (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss Poster style When layout Then strict grid, mathematical precision, asymmetric balance
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：严格网格、数学精度、非对称平衡、留白空间

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss Poster style When UI elements Then clean lines, geometric shapes, objective photography
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：干净线条、几何形状、客观摄影、精确对齐

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss Poster UI When functional Then includes systematic chat, grid agents, module stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：系统化聊天、网格代理、模块统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss Poster UI When copy Then uses modernist language: 'Grid', 'System', 'Order', 'Precision'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'GRID. SYSTEM. ORDER.'、按钮'SEND'→'EXECUTE'、'SUBMIT'→'ORGANIZE'
